_read_me: pii-log-grep suite (config/benchmarks/pii-log-grep.json). `sampleLogClean` and `sampleLogViolation` are small synthetic log captures used ONLY by --self-test, so the suite can prove its detection logic works without spawning the full `npm test` run every time. `sampleLogViolation` embeds a deliberately fake cuid, phone number, and email — none of them real — to prove the scorer actually flags a violation rather than always reporting zero. A real run ignores both fields and either reads $BENCH_TEST_LOG or spawns `npm test` itself.
sampleLogClean: not a logger line at all, just test runner chatter: 24 passing (312ms)
